summary.zh: 先降技能消耗，再补移动速度、暴击，并在 25 级拿到 Primal Bite。全部点数投入野性战斗，60 级时就是一套完整的野性天赋。
summary.en: Cheaper attacks first, then speed, crit, and Primal Bite at 25. Every point goes into Feral Combat, so the build is already a full Feral setup at 60.

scenario.zh: 10–60 级，猎豹形态单刷任务，难打的怪切熊形态
scenario.en: Levels 10–60, solo questing in Cat Form with Bear Form for tough pulls

pros.zh: 凶暴从第一点起就让爪击、扫击和槌击更省资源，两种形态开怪都更从容。
pros.en: Ferocity makes Claw, Rake, and Maul cheaper from your first point, so you open fights with more resources in both forms.

pros.zh: 豹之迅捷提供 30% 猎豹形态移动速度和 4% 躲闪，在 30 级拿到旅行形态之前跑图更快。
pros.en: Feral Swiftness adds 30% Cat Form run speed and 4% dodge: faster travel between quests before Travel Form at 30.

pros.zh: 16 点里程碑天赋 Primal Bite 在 25 级到手；随后血之狂暴让暴击额外获得连击点和怒气。
pros.en: Primal Bite, the 16-point milestone, lands at level 25; Blood Frenzy then turns critical strikes into extra combo points and rage.

pros.zh: 野性之心、Shifting Power 与狂乱撕扯在 30–40 级持续提升伤害，50 级拿到狂暴。
pros.en: Heart of the Wild, Shifting Power, and Rend and Tear raise damage through the 30s and 40s, and Berserk arrives at 50.

pros.zh: 经常在地下城当坦克？把自然反射提前到狂乱撕扯之后，不必留到最后。
pros.en: Grouping for dungeons as the tank? Take Natural Reaction right after Rend and Tear instead of at the end.

pros.zh: 24 级的野性冲锋在练级时可以缓一缓，先点野蛮冲撞或野性本能也可以。
pros.en: Feral Charge at 24 is optional while leveling; Brutal Impact or an early Feral Instinct point works too.
